examples.english: It’s really a shame that they're letting the house fall into ruin like that.
examples.translation: It’s really a shame that they're letting the house fall into ruin like that.

examples.text: Zonde van de tijd!
examples.english: What a waste of time!
examples.translation: What a waste of time!

head_templates.expansion: zonde f (plural zonden or zondes, diminutive zondetje n)
zweepstaart m (plural zweepstaarten, diminutive zweepstaartje n)
